paragraphs.text: Hazezon Tamar was the governor of Bryce on Dominaria , during the time the city-state experienced Johan's War , a conflict with Tirras orchestrated by Johan .

Hazezon Tamar had hazel-colored eyes. His skin was as dark as tanned leather and was covered with a white mustache and beard. He was of middling girth and advancing years. Hazezon wore the traditional garb of Jamuraa's desert seacoast: a loose robe of pale brown deftly embroidered, a keffiyeh head scarf of white as befit a ruler, and a multicaped cloak of amber stitched with gold thread. A brass-hiked scimitar was shoved through his sash, a trapping of office, but his real weapon was his mind. His horse was named Belladonna .

Hazezon's official title was Tetrarch of the Free Realm of Bryce, but he went by many titles, including the governor, lord paramount, suzerain, and the old-fashioned pasha. He is known to make referential exclamations instead of cursing. These include: "Tower of the Tabernacle !", " Great Defender !", "Jewels of Jasmine !" , "Mercy of the Mothers!" , " Eye of Orms-By-Gore! , " Khabal's ghoul! " , " Scarzam 's dragon !" , "Lady Evangela give me strength!" , "By the beard of Boris !" , and "Beard of Ragnar !"

Hazezon rallied his ex-wife Adira Strongheart and her Robaran Mercenaries with the aid of Jaeger Ojanen , a strange tiger man of the forest of Efrava . After Jaeger's death, Hazezon allied with Jaeger's son, Jedit Ojanen , eventually ending Johan's War by ensuring his death.
